record.label: Network-adaptive rank-16 cross-unit residual covariance observer
record.summary: The independently verified fourfold/inner-cross-fit rank-16 covariance observer is finite on all 688 OOF rows at final MSE 3.230119894372402e-8 versus J 3.2334958229470984e-8, only a 0.1044049% improvement. Fold MSEs are 3.151103526735653e-8, 3.267479855636035e-8, 3.3542892093804806e-8, and 3.1490923178010657e-8; maximum per-network MSE is 3.4171608557348345e-7 at rank643/mlp364. It fails the aggregate, every-fold, and maximum-network accuracy gates; observer_selection remained sealed and no name join occurred. Read-only decomposition shows 86.694% cancellation and alignment—not covariance amplitude—explains gain. Even exact truth-derived coefficients in its one dynamic rank-16 span reach only 2.8928320722187982e-8, recovering 10.535% of J endpoint error versus 69.076% required. CV, verification, and decomposition are frozen at SHA-256 37187da1fabdc84951a5bc68ef3f12fba1d4b940bc19027c8426f59f1b61be37, 9b6a00d819eb219c8eada6242d96821a76abbfda2076e21f263d079113cb7645, and 007ba020154fed4ca2dd63f16fd10b4961c85f4bd8f5b719cc131acafb53f82a.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for this exact diagonal-plus-rank-16 covariance observer because it fails all frozen accuracy conjuncts and its single factor-span oracle remains 2.893x above target. Do not retune, scale rank, run a literal meter, or promote it; preserve only the materially different full-rank nonlinear round-trip design P2R0F2P.
